text:
lina: Auditor Elliot just asked for proof of the RBAC change we applied to inference-service-prod yesterday (2024-04-11 18:10 UTC). They want the PR, diff of role bindings, and session/audit logs including KMS decrypt events for the prod key. Can we bundle artifacts?

sara: I can package the PR and change justification. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infraprod/pull/4923

matt: @lina I'll grab the rolebinding diff and run exports from Splunk + CloudTrail for KMS. Which exact key alias should I target?

lina: Alias is alias/redwood-prod-kms (key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12-3456). Need time-ordered proofs with checksums and a manifest. Auditor asked to avoid including raw emails.

matt: Starting Splunk query to pull RBAC change + sessions. Query:
```
index=rbac change_type=update service=inference-service user=* | table _time user action resource details
```
I'll also pull CloudTrail eventName=Decrypt entries for the key.

deploy-bot: Export task started: export-id-7890 -> s3://redwood-audit-exports/inference/rbac-20240411/export-7890.tar.gz (ACL: private, encrypted with alias/redwood-audit)

sara: I'll create manifest file and include PR link, approver, deployment id, and sha256 checksums. Template:
```
name: inference-rbac-20240411
pr: 4923
approver: min-jun (eng manager)
files:
  - rbac.diff
  - cloudtrail-decrypt.csv
  - splunk-rbac.csv
  - approval-screenshot.png
sha256: <populate later>
```

auditor_elliot: Also need confirmation that KMS key access is granted to a service role (not a human user). Provide role-to-key policy and any relevant IAM role mappings.

lina: KMS key policy snippet (redacted):
```
{ 'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [ { 'Sid': 'AllowInferenceRole', 'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': { 'AWS': 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/inference-gkms-role' }, 'Action': [ 'kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey' ] } ] }
```

matt: Pulled CloudTrail filter: `eventName=Decrypt AND requestParameters.keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12-3456` -> got events at 2024-04-11T18:10:22Z and 2024-04-11T18:11:05Z executed by role/inference-gkms-role. Exporting CSV.

auditor_elliot: Great. We also need a signed timeline: who approved the PR and who executed the change. A SHA256 of the manifest plus a screenshot of the approver's sign-off is acceptable.

sara: PR was approved by @min-jun (eng manager). I'll include the approval screenshot (redacting emails) and generate sha256(manifest).

lina: Heads up — some older session logs were moved to Glacier by lifecycle policy. Auditor asked for full chain; we may need to restore objects. @matt can you check retention and initiate restore if needed?

matt: Retention for CloudTrail is 180 days; S3 lifecycle transitions objects to Glacier after 60 days. The specific archive for 2024-04-11 was transitioned. Initiating expedited restore request for s3://redwood-logs/cloudtrail/2024/04/11/ct-20240411.tar.gz (restore request id: restore-231). ETA ~36 hours.

deploy-bot: S3 restore request submitted: restore-task-231 -> s3://redwood-audit-exports/restore/inference-20240411.tar.gz (status: in-progress)

auditor_elliot: Understood. Also include a mapping to SOC 2 / ISO controls: short table mapping PR/approval to CC6.1 / A.9.2, role binding diffs to logging controls, KMS Decrypt events to key management controls. A paragraph per mapping is fine.

lina: I'll draft the control mapping and attach it to the manifest. Plan: deliver preliminary package (PR, diffs, CloudTrail decrypts we already have, Splunk extracts, manifest with checksums) in ~2 hours. We'll follow up with restored objects and updated checksums.

auditor_elliot: :thumbsup: That timeline works. Please flag any artifacts that include PII so we can coordinate redaction review before delivery.

sara: noted — approval screenshot will be redacted for personal emails. We'll mark files that may contain PII in the manifest.

matt: CSVs and diffs will be stored encrypted in s3://redwood-audit-exports/inference/1723502468/ and I'll add object etags and sha256 values to manifest when ready.

lina: Thanks team — keep updates here. If restore ETA slips beyond 48h we'll escalate to infra.

auditor_elliot: Thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround.
